name: SiteMedic Rescue Toolkit
author: prakashghai

sections.description:
SiteMedic Rescue Toolkit helps site owners diagnose and safely repair common website issues from inside the WordPress dashboard.

The plugin includes local diagnostic and repair tools such as site health checks, plugin risk review, debug log review, file permission checks, performance checks, database review, cleanup tools, rewrite rule repair, and safety guidance.

All built-in local plugin tools included in this WordPress.org version are available without a license key, payment, trial, quota, or time restriction.

Optional professional help is available separately from Professional Support. This is not required to use the plugin.

External Services

This plugin may link to Professional Support only when a site administrator chooses to visit the optional services page.

Service: Professional Support
Purpose: optional professional website troubleshooting services
Data sent automatically: none
Website: https://www.wpofficialsupport.com/
Privacy Policy: https://www.wpofficialsupport.com/privacy-policy/
Terms: https://www.wpofficialsupport.com/terms-and-conditions/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/sitemedic-rescue-toolkit directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen.
  3. Open SiteMedic Rescue Toolkit from the admin menu.
sections.faq:
Are the included tools locked behind a license key?

No. All built-in local tools included in this WordPress.org version are available without a license key, payment, trial, quota, or time restriction.

Does this plugin process payments?

No. This WordPress.org version does not process payments and does not unlock local features through payment.

Can I get professional help?

Yes. The optional services page links to Professional Support for separate professional troubleshooting help.
